parameters.content:
## B · Search
Receives all search tasks of a run (e.g. **Bangladesh × bn × gov_report**) and runs each one with the engine chosen on the run page:
**Codex agent (default):** one Codex CLI session per task in the `codex-runner` container, 3 at a time. The Search Skill becomes Codex's `AGENTS.md`; Codex works in many steps with live web search and a shell (curl, pdftotext): it opens pages, downloads and reads PDFs, follows publication lists, and checks every candidate before listing it. Each session's full transcript and downloads are kept in `./codex-runs/`.
**Single API call:** the earlier engine, one OpenAI call with built-in web search per task.
Every task is logged in the `search_runs` table (engine, time, tokens, commands, candidates) for comparison.

### 🧑‍🔬 Search Skill in
The full text of `skills/search/SKILL.md`, plus the domain module chosen on the run page, arrives with every task. Codex receives it as `AGENTS.md`, the single API call as its instructions.

parameters.query:
-- run_id = the Codex session folder in ./codex-runs; pipeline_run = the run page's run (runs.id)
INSERT INTO search_runs (engine, domain, country, language, source_type, candidates, duration_s, commands, web_searches,
                         input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, run_id, queries, error, academic, pipeline_run)
SELECT engine, NULLIF(domain, ''), country, language, source_type, candidates, duration_s, commands, web_searches,
       input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, NULLIF(codex_run, ''), queries, NULLIF(error, ''), academic, pipeline_run
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(engine text, domain text, country text, language text, source_type text, candidates int, duration_s int,
     commands int, web_searches int, input_tokens bigint, cached_input_tokens bigint, output_tokens bigint, codex_run text, queries jsonb, error text,
     academic jsonb, pipeline_run bigint)
